cohort: The study included 8 Sprague Dawley rats per group, divided into control, DMSO, EA, IUA, IUA+DMSO, and IUA+EA groups.
finding: Ellagic acid treatment in the IUA model rats decreased fibrotic structure, supported by down-regulation of TGFb1 and up-regulation of BMP7, and increased implantation rates by enhancing endometrial receptivity via increased LIF expression.
